AREAD104.DAT:8:3.t: [0C][06][14][C6]@"Tu es aquele que afirma ser um deus?"

AREAD104.DAT:8:4.risk_notes: Intentional broken EN preserved as crude/simpleminded entity speech in pt-BR. 'Me god' = broken grammar (tu nao sou/Me nao sou). Risk: ensure translation sounds equally primitive without gibberish.

AREAD104.DAT:8:5.risk_notes: Identity/philosophy core to Fou-Lu's arc; arcaic registers (hath/doth/art) convey superiority and tragedy. Glossary: 'Endless' = 'Eternos'. Long line (334 byte budget); must fit without truncation. [14][82]B = format token for italic/emphasis (preserve exact). Back-translation mandatory.
AREAD104.DAT:8:5.t: [0C][06][14][C6]@"Tu nao es um deus.[02][14][82]BTu es apenas uma mera sombra...Algo que bebeu da borra do poder dos deuses e acredita que assim te tornaste um deus tambem.[02]Tu fostes afetado pelo nosso poder e o dos outros, nada mais."

AREAD104.DAT:8:6.speaker: unknown
AREAD104.DAT:8:6.risk_notes: Broken speech patterns maintained (intentional characterization of entity). Repetition of 'puny man' (homem minusculo) and speech impediment consistent with prior line. Risk: naturalness in pt-BR while preserving stupidity effect.
AREAD104.DAT:8:6.t: [0C][05][14][01][01]"Eu nao entendo homem minusculo. Homem minusculo fala estranho.[02]Homem minusculo acha que eu sou estupido?"

AREAD104.DAT:8:7.speaker: Fou-Lu
AREAD104.DAT:8:7.risk_notes: Fou-Lu's core existential question; arcaic 'needeth' and 'sayest' critical. Mark [83]C = format token (preserve). Philosophical weight must survive translation. Back-translation required.
AREAD104.DAT:8:7.t: [0C][06][14][83]C"Talvez...Talvez o mundo nao necessite de deuses?[02]Que dizes tu disso?"

AREAD104.DAT:8:8.speaker: unknown
AREAD104.DAT:8:8.t: [0C][05][14][01][01]"Homem minusculo nao faz sentido. Eu nao entendo homem minusculo.[02]Eu mato homem minusculo."

AREAD104.DAT:8:9.speaker: Fou-Lu
AREAD104.DAT:8:9.intent: explaining the arrival of Endless and its consequences
AREAD104.DAT:8:9.risk_notes: Glossary term: 'Endless' = 'Eternos' (established). Long exposition (335 byte budget); cosmic/lore-heavy; arcaic registers (doth/hath) essential. Explains world mythology. [14] = section marker (preserve). Back-translation mandatory.
AREAD104.DAT:8:9.t: [14][C6]@"Os Eternos sao invocados para esta esfera...[02]Isto muda o equilibrio da propria Natureza,[02]inundando o mundo com energias tanto poderosas quanto perigosas,[02]e faz com que seres facilmente influenciados por ela pensem que sao deuses..."

AREAD104.DAT:8:12.speaker: npc
AREAD104.DAT:8:12.t: [14][84]D"O que voce fez pro deus da montanha!?"

AREAD104.DAT:8:13.speaker: npc
AREAD104.DAT:8:13.risk_notes: Shift from 'god' to questioning party's identity/nature; foreshadows revelation. Must preserve rural speech ('Normal folks don't be' = 'Gente normal nao anda'; colloquial contraction). Risk: spoiler adjacent — do not resolve identity prematurely.
AREAD104.DAT:8:13.t: [14][84]D"Gente normal nao anda por ai,[02]fazendo coisa assim...[02]Quem e voces? Nao, espera-- O que e voces?"
